SoftwareWellness application

HealRoot.

A Bulgarian-language journal with guided audio and appointment booking.

Overview

HealRoot brings three everyday tasks into a Bulgarian-language wellness app. Users can keep a personal journal, listen to guided sessions and book time with a practitioner.

From an entry to a session

A journal entry and its history give the user a personal record. Guided audio and a player with frequency and volume controls support a separate listening session.

Two paths through the product

Personal journaling and audio sit alongside a practitioner directory. Booking and checkout belong to that second path and require the corresponding service integrations.

Capabilities

  • Record journal entries and inspect trends in a personal analytics view.
  • Play guided audio and explore wellness content through a chat interface.
  • Browse practitioner profiles, request a session and complete the booking checkout.

One workflow

  1. Journal entry
  2. Browse sessions
  3. Session booking

Development

The July and August 2026 project history follows the React interface through to account setup, administrative controls and backend functions for sessions and subscriptions.
